note: The quantifier's body node is captured for emptiness checking.
quantifiers_memory_node_info traverses the body tree, reading NODE_TYPE on each node. If a node in the body tree was already freed, this is a READ 4 use-after-free.
Reads the type field (4 bytes) of a node that may have been freed by a prior tune_tree call on a parent or sibling subtree.

code: case NODE_QUANT: r = tune_quant(node, reg, state, env);
note: tune_tree dispatches to tune_quant for quantifier nodes, which triggers the UAF read in quantifiers_memory_node_info.
